description: Save a public web page as an A4 PDF and return a link to the file. Use it when the user wants a document to keep, share or archive. The PDF is not shown to you; to look at a page use capture_screenshot. Costs 1 screenshot of the monthly quota per call, failed captures included. Takes about 9-25 seconds. The link is public to anyone who has it and expires in 30 days. Limits: the page must be reachable from the public internet (no localhost or private networks).

custom_css.description: CSS injected before the PDF is made, for example print tweaks.

hide_selectors.description: CSS selector(s) to hide (display:none) before capture, comma-separated, for example ".newsletter-popup, #ad-banner".

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page, reachable from the public internet. localhost and private-network addresses cannot be captured; use render_html for local HTML.

wait_ms.description: Extra wait in milliseconds after load, before the capture. API default 2000. Raise it for late animations or client-side rendering.

wait_until.description: When the page counts as loaded. API default "networkidle2". Use "domcontentloaded" for heavy or slow sites (fastest, most reliable); "networkidle0" waits for all network activity to stop.

name: capture_pdf

pdf_url.description: The PDF file. Public to anyone who has the link.

title: Capture PDF
